data.name: Tank Them All
data.detailed_description:
LOAD. AIM. DOMINATE.

Tank Them All is a chaotic top-down arena shooter where six tanks enter — and only one leaves. Blast your friends into oblivion across 90+ hand-crafted arenas, grab game-changing power-ups, and survive everything from poison clouds to air raids.

4 GAME MODES. ENDLESS CHAOS.

⚔ Free For All

Pure, unfiltered mayhem. Last tank rolling wins. Set your own rules — play by rounds or rack up kills.

🤝 Team Battle

Two teams, one winner. Revive fallen teammates with the Repair power-up and coordinate fire — friendly fire is OFF, but accidents happen.

🏆 King of the Hill

A glowing zone appears on the arena. Hold it. Score points every second you're inside. But the zone shrinks — and moves. Respawn, adapt, survive.

🐚 Golden Shell

One golden shell drops somewhere on the map. Pick it up and you become the most dangerous — and most hunted — tank on the battlefield. Score points every second you hold it. Kill while holding for a bonus. Die and it's gone.

16 POWER-UPS. INFINITE COMBINATIONS.

Collect up to 3 power-ups simultaneously and stack brutal combinations:

  • Homing Missile— locks on and chases enemies

  • Bounce Bullet — ricochets off walls to hit from impossible angles

  • Boomerang — fires forward, curves back, hits twice

  • Explosion Shell — area-damage devastation

  • Nitro — speed boost to chase or escape

  • Shield — absorbs one lethal hit

  • Ice Path — leave a slippery trail that disrupts enemies

  • Dash Killer — your dash becomes a lethal weapon

  • Artillery — call in a strike from above

  • Mine — plant traps and control the arena

  •  ...and 6 more

THE ARENA FIGHTS BACK.

Surviving other players isn't enough. Every match can bring:

  • ☁ Poison Cloud — deadly gas closes in from the edges

  • 💣 Minefield — the battlefield perimeter becomes a death zone

  • 🌪 Tornado — weather turns violent during storms

  • ✈ Air Raid — bombs fall from the sky at timed intervals

90+ ARENAS. NEVER THE SAME MATCH TWICE.

Sand dunes. Dense jungles. Lakes. Radar stations. Each arena is a different battlefield — different cover, different flow, different strategy. A new arena is loaded every round.

LOCAL & ONLINE — PLAY YOUR WAY.

🎮 Local Multiplayer

Up to 6 players on one machine. Couch chaos at its finest.

🌐 Online Multiplayer

Create a lobby and share a code, or browse open rooms and jump straight in. Fill any empty slot with AI bots — whether you're playing locally or online.

No matter how you play, bots adapt to the game mode: they hunt power-ups, contest King of the Hill zones, and chase down the Golden Shell holder.

QUICK TO LEARN. HARD TO MASTER.

One stick to move. One button to charge and fire. Then it gets complicated — in the best possible way.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 265
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1300 MB available space
